Project overview

The second phase of the Babylon Sky Garden brand, a completed building of 49 apartments on about 3,200 sqm in Rawai, around 1.4 km by road from Wat Sawang Arom. The developer reports construction from late 2023 to the end of 2025; the portal records completion in December 2025.

Advertised units range from studios of about 43-45 sqm to two-bedroom apartments of up to 142 sqm. Shared areas include a pool, kids pool, bar, gym, reception and parking for about three-quarters of units.

The floor count differs between sources (six on the portal, five on the developer site), so it is stated as six storeys per the portal.

Babylon Sky Garden 2: key facts

  • Babylon Sky Garden 2 is a boutique condominium in Rawai, Phuket, developed by Billfishing Phuket Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 0–2 bedrooms, 43.2–142.4 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Dec 2025.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,782,500.
